snip.cap: ASMo Ambasciatori Ungheria b. 4, Caprile to Pistofilo, 9 March 1519: the block in the 1519 two-tier cipher
snip.credit: Archivio di Stato di Modena, Ambasciatori, Ungheria b. 4, Caprili 1519–20 no. 1, p. 1, via Vestigia 1853

system: Two-tier cipher: a small sign over a base stroke (7, m, n, a, t, 4), with bracket-L signs for whole words.
